description: Image Description: The image depicts a weathered and moss-covered stone sculpture scene set against a rustic stone wall. The central figures are three characters resembling classic children's storybook toys, sculpted from stone and heavily aged by time and nature. On the right is a bear-like figure with a round face, black button eyes, a prominent nose, and a red scarf around its neck—resembling Winnie the Pooh.
